title: Differentiable Knapsack and Top-k Operators via Dynamic Programming
abstract: arXiv:2601.21775v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Knapsack and Top-k operators are useful for selecting discrete subsets of variables. However, their integration into neural networks is challenging as they are piecewise constant, yielding gradients that are zero almost everywhere. In this paper, we propose a unified framework casting these operators as dynamic programs, and derive differentiable relaxations by smoothing the underlying recursions. On the algorithmic side, we develop efficient parallel algorithms supporting both deterministic and stochastic forward passes, and vector-Jacobian products for the backward pass. On the theoretical side, we prove that Shannon's negative entropy is the unique separable regularization choice that yields permutation-equivariant operators, and characterize regularizers inducing sparse selections. translated_title: 基于动态规划的可微分背包与Top-k算子
translated_abstract: 背包和Top-k算子对于选择变量的离散子集非常有用。然而，将它们集成到神经网络中极具挑战性，因为它们是分段常数的函数，其梯度几乎处处为零。在本文中，我们提出了一个统一框架，将这些算子建模为动态规划问题，并通过平滑底层的递推关系推导出可微分松弛。在算法方面，我们开发了高效的并行算法，支持确定性和随机的前向传播，以及用于反向传播的向量-雅可比积。在理论方面，我们证明了香农负熵是唯一能够产生置换等变算子的可分离正则化选择，并刻画了能够诱导稀疏选择的正则化子。在实验方面，我们在学习预测背包问题解决方案的基准测试、离散VAE的扩展等任务上展示了我们框架的有效性。
tldr: 本文提出一个统一框架，将背包与Top-k算子转化为动态规划并平滑递推得到可微分松弛，配有高效并行前向与反向算法，并从理论上证明香农负熵是唯一保证置换等变性的可分离正则化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified framework that casts knapsack and top-k operators as dynamic programs with smoothed differentiable relaxations, supported by efficient parallel forward and backward algorithms, and proves that Shannon's negative entropy is the unique separable regularizer yielding permutation-equivariant operators.
